Delhi Air Quality Worsens as Monsoon Withdraws, Winter Pollution Looms

Delhi's Air Quality Index (AQI) has risen to 151 following the withdrawal of the monsoon season. This marks the beginning of the winter pollution cycle, with authorities planning pollution control measures for the upcoming season. On Wednesday, the minimum temperature recorded at Safdarjung was 24.8°C, and the maximum temperature was 36.1°C, with rainfall occurring throughout the day.
